scope: Static concepts of the five fully visible products. No storefront changes. Artwork and typography are approximations.

prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity flat desktop website section layout concept for Hey Kahani, using the attached screenshot as the content and artwork reference. Output a crisp landscape UI image, approximately 2384 pixels wide, no perspective, device frame, presentation board, watermark or annotations. This is a layout-only exploration. Same white page ground, warm Kesar Sand #FFF1D6 product surfaces, black text, Gulab Red #D3000A pill Add to bag buttons with white labels and subtle soft red shadows. Body/interface uses Open Sans; section heading Averia Serif Libre. Preserve circular illustrated Koel discs and their exact scene identities, never replace them with square book covers. Reuse the five artworks from the screenshot faithfully. No new artwork subjects. Keep products in reading order: 1. Holi Kite Play, badge Kahani Original, 2. Kerala Houseboat, badge Kahani Original, 3. Festival Family, badge Celebrate the year, 4. Park Mindfulness, badge Kahani Original, 5. Market & Temple Travel, badge Wander with wonder. Every product has exactly two text-labelled actions: a black play triangle plus Preview and a red Add to bag pill. Each card must have its own correct title, badge and both actions fully visible and legible. Preserve exact spelling. Do not add ratings, hearts, wishlist, prices, ranks, ages, durations, ribbons, filters, arrows, navigation, carts or other controls, explanatory copy or decorative doodles. The section top contains existing heading "Find their next favourite Koel." and existing sentence "Browse the catalogue. Preview a cover, then add it to the bag when you’re ready." with existing "View all" link at right. Show ONLY the same five complete products for comparing layouts, without inventing partial products beneath. Shorten excessive art-to-title whitespace. All UI must be professionally spaced, aligned, unclipped and realistic to implement in CSS. DIRECTION A: COMPACT UNIFIED CARDS. One row of five equal-width cream rounded cards, each a single contained unit including BOTH actions. Each card roughly 400 px tall at 2384 px canvas width, 24 px gaps and 80 px page gutters. Large circular product artwork close to top, then a modest gap to the title in black bold Open Sans, then original category pill, then a shared bottom-aligned footer row with Preview at left and Add to bag at right. Keep card heights identical, titles wrap gracefully up to two lines with aligned category and footer baselines. Stronger visual grouping than original screenshot, substantially shorter cards, no long empty middle. All content fully inside each card. No separate white action strips outside cards. Product image largest element; title second; badge third. White page margin around the row. Output only this design.
